Name: Nostalgia Abigail
Author: Cilbas
Description:
[center][size=6]- [color=#009cff]Nostalgia Abigail[/color] -[/size]


[size=1]BASED ON[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/140-0-1458841075.png[/img]
[ [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Abigail]Source[/url] ]


Simple edit of Abigail's [u]portrait and sprite[/u] to resemble her older character design.
[size=1][color=#ff7700]NEW![/color][/size] Added optional version without the pink bow.
All files are standalone - [u]download only one[/u]!


[size=1]THANK YOU TO EVERYONE FOR TRYING OUT MY MOD // FEEDBACK IS ALWAYS WELCOME[/size][/center]


[size=5][color=#009cff]Compatibility[/color][/size]

This mod is not compatible with any mod that replaces the following files:
[list]
[*][size=2][ [size=1]ABIGAIL'S SPRITE[/size] ] [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Abigail.xnb[/font][/size]
[*][size=2][ [size=1]ABIGAIL'S PORTRAIT[/size] ] [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits\Abigail.xnb[/font][/size]
[/list]


[size=5][color=#009cff]Installation[/color][/size]

0. Backup your game files! (the [font=Courier New]Content[/font] folder or just the files listed above)

1. Download mod

2. Extract

3. Move the contents to your main Stardew Valley game folder (where [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley.exe[/font] is) and replace files when prompted.

4. Play the game


[size=5][color=#009cff]Uninstall[/color][/size]

1. Restore backup
